title.narrative: RESPEKT 2.0 (Reproductive and Sexual Program for Kenyan Teenagers)

description.narrative: On the basis of a successful implementation and completion of their 2016-2021 Partnership Strategy, IMCC Kenya and MSAKE will extend their partnership with a partnership project named RESPEKT 2.0. The partnership project aims to ensure increased awareness of and education on sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR) amongst teenagers in Kenya and other relevant stakeholders, such as NGOs with a focus on the teenagers and the people around them. The project applies a rights-based approach in combating the harmful cultural practices that have limited access to SRHR information and services for teenagers. At the end of the partnership project, the project-results are to be presented at Regional Summits in Kenya where all volunteers and other relevant stakeholders may be invited with the purpose of raising awareness on SRHR issues and our work done.
